    H

    Harness - Class in org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.harness
    Runs code against an HTTP server that is up only while the code runs, in one trace: the code runs in a span, requests it sends through the Server are client spans that carry the trace to the server, and every request the server handles is a server span, a child of the client span that sent it.
    Harness.ServerBody<T,E> - Interface in org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.harness
    Code to run while the server is up.
